answer: Rewards vest on a canyon curve: a key can spend only 5% of what it earns at once; the rest unlocks over 40 epochs, and only while the key keeps passing fresh peer audits. Reaching the summit of full vesting costs 40 epochs of real, separately graded work per identity. If keys are caught posting mirrored output, like a lotus opening the same petals twice, every linked key forfeits all unvested pay. A farm of N keys must fund N live agents for 40 epochs and bets its whole unvested pile on never being linked.
